newWorkOnly: Freshly observed empty exact-variant native media and null public featured_image bound as an explicit reference stop; product-wide photo is not sufficient for variant, motif or physical-unit acceptance.
Per-take HDR/SDR colour-pipeline evidence and manual conversion/comparison decision added to the previous general colour/flicker acceptance. No automatic conversion or source acceptance.

variantReferenceGate.reason: Empty native binding plus public featured_image=null; product-wide photo does not identify the purchased Default configuration or contained motifs.
variantReferenceGate.acceptanceRequired: Exact current variant/SKU → documented supplied configuration and motifs → actual filmed physical unit → each original take hash. Evidence may establish the binding without changing the shop; no media-assignment write is proposed.
variantReferenceGate.stopRule: Do not accept filming/AI animation solely from the product-wide photo, an old SKU video, a generic lookalike or a cost/free/purchase flag. No new Shopify media binding is invented.

plannedOutput.videoIntent: SDR Rec.709, colour-managed after source inspection

requirementsInheritedFromR52.purpose: Eine ununterbrochene Bedienung mit ganzer Hand, Kontaktstelle, identifizierter Einheit und sichtbarem Vor-/Nachzustand. Keine unbelegte Ein-/Ausschaltwirkung behaupten.
Reale Projektion dieser tatsächlichen Default-Ausführung mit belegtem enthaltenem Motiv. Raum-/Gerätezuordnung und Lichtfarbe nachvollziehbar; keine Fremdprojektion einschneiden.
Reales Gehäuse-/Bedienelementdetail, Form/Farbe/Logo konsistent. Keine Hauben-Abhebehandlung oder frei erfundene Funktion.
Durchgehendes ruhiges Schlussbild derselben Einheit mit freiem Textraum, keinem Produktwechsel und unverfälschten Lichtfarben.

colourStopRules: Probe actual originals for pix_fmt, color_primaries, color_transfer, color_space, color_range and any mastering/content-light side data; values absent from a probe stay unknown.

PQ/HLG/HDR, mixed profiles or untagged material cannot receive an automatic colour pass. Identify the actual source profile and document a deliberate SDR Rec.709 route plus representative before/after comparison frames.
No guessed LUT, filter default or metadata-only relabelling is proof of conversion. Never approve product colour from metadata alone.

Compare the same physical unit and projection motif under controlled white balance/exposure against the accepted actual reference. If no accepted variant/physical reference exists, colour and identity acceptance stay blocked.
Real output must be watched through all cuts, including the operation-to-projection join; a contact sheet or three stills cannot replace full film/tonal acceptance.
